decode_pdf_pages: decode PDF bytes into PIL images using fitz or pypdfium2 with configurable page indices and render DPI
decode_image_pages: decode multi-page image files like TIFF into a list of PIL images with optional random page sampling
create_DecodeDoc: create a DecodeDoc instance for webdataset-based PDF and TIFF decoding with configurable imagespec and page sampling strategy
DecodeDoc_call: call a DecodeDoc instance with a key and data bytes to decode PDF or TIFF pages into numpy arrays or torch tensors
create_image_decoder: create a webdataset image decoder with optional PDF and TIFF document support using a configurable image mode and handler
